quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that keeps our chest and back warm but arms free?
quests.question: Vest
quests.hint: It covers your chest and back, but your arms are free.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Vest covers your chest with no sleeves, so your arms stay free!
quests.funFact: Some vests are worn for fancy outfits, and some for safety at work.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear on our feet under our shoes?
quests.question: Socks
quests.hint: Think about this: You wear two, one for each foot.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Socks keep your feet warm and make your shoes comfortable!
quests.funFact: Socks keep our feet warm and make shoes comfortable!

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear over everything else when it is very cold outside?
quests.question: Coat
quests.hint: Think about this: You wear this over all your other clothes.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Coat is thick and warm, worn over everything else in cold weather!
quests.funFact: A warm coat can keep you toasty even in freezing weather!

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear with soft, bouncy soles that cushion every step?
quests.question: Sneakers
quests.hint: They have bouncy, cushioned soles.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Sneakers have bouncy soles that make running and jumping comfortable!
quests.funFact: Sneakers used to be called 'sneaks' because they were so quiet to walk in.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear to stay warm and cozy indoors?
quests.question: Sweater
quests.hint: Think about this: You pull this over your head.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Sweater is soft and warm, perfect for chilly days indoors or out!
quests.funFact: Many sweaters are knitted from soft, warm yarn!

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear first, before we put on our shirt and pants?
quests.question: Underwear
quests.hint: You change into a fresh, clean pair every day.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Underwear is worn closest to your skin, under all your other clothes!
quests.funFact: Changing into clean underwear every day helps you stay fresh and healthy.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear on our legs on a hot summer day?
quests.question: Shorts
quests.hint: Think about this: They stop above your knees.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Shorts keep your legs cool and free to move on hot days!
quests.funFact: Shorts keep your legs cool on hot summer days!

quests.instruction: What do we wear with just one little pocket for the thumb?
quests.question: Mittens
quests.hint: Hint: They are even warmer than regular gloves.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Mittens keep your fingers snuggled together, which makes them extra warm!
quests.funFact: Mittens are often warmer than gloves because your fingers share heat.

quests.instruction: What do we wear instead of closed shoes when the weather is hot?
quests.question: Sandals
quests.hint: Hint: They are perfect for a hot, sunny beach day.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Sandals have open straps that let your feet stay cool in the sun!
quests.funFact: Sandals are one of the oldest kinds of footwear people have worn.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear that has short sleeves and pulls over our head?
quests.question: T-Shirt
quests.hint: Think about this: It simply pulls over your head, no buttons needed.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your T-Shirt has short sleeves and pulls over your head easily!
quests.funFact: A T-shirt is one of the comfiest things you can wear to play in.

quests.instruction: What do we wear backward sometimes just for fun?
quests.question: Cap
quests.hint: Hint: Some people flip these around backward for fun.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Cap has a curved front brim that shades your eyes from the sun!
quests.funFact: Some people like to wear their cap turned backward for fun.

quests.instruction: What do we wear instead of a plain sweater, for extra warmth and fun?
quests.question: Hoodie
quests.hint: Hint: You can pull the hood up over your hair.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Hoodie has a warm hood attached that you can pull up over your head!
quests.funFact: Hoodies became popular because they keep your head warm without a hat.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear over our shirt to protect us from chilly wind?
quests.question: Jacket
quests.hint: Think about this: It has long sleeves and often a zipper.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Jacket keeps chilly wind off your body so you stay warm!
quests.funFact: Some jackets have a hood you can pull up in the rain.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear on our head on a sunny day?
quests.question: Hat
quests.hint: Think about this: It covers your hair.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Hat sits on top of your head to keep it warm or shady!
quests.funFact: People wear all kinds of hats, from tiny caps to huge sun hats.

quests.instruction: What do we wear to a wedding or a very special occasion?
quests.question: Tie
quests.hint: Hint: You wear this for a fancy, formal event.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Tie is knotted at the collar to make an outfit look fancy and formal!
quests.funFact: Some people wear a small bow tie instead of a long, hanging tie.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that stretches and moves easily when we run and jump?
quests.question: Leggings
quests.hint: Hint: You can wear these under a skirt or dress.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Leggings are soft and stretchy, moving easily with your legs when you play!
quests.funFact: The stretchy fabric in leggings helps you bend, jump, and stretch with ease.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear that covers our body in one long piece?
quests.question: Dress
quests.hint: Think about this: It often twirls when you spin.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Dress is one piece of clothing that covers your whole body at once!
quests.funFact: Some dresses twirl beautifully when you spin around.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear on our feet that reach up past our ankles?
quests.question: Boots
quests.hint: Think about this: They are perfect for muddy puddles.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Boots reach up past your ankle to keep your feet safe and dry!
quests.funFact: Some boots are made specially to keep your feet completely dry.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that buckles snugly at the front?
quests.question: Belt
quests.hint: Hint: It buckles at the front to stay snug.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Belt goes around your waist to keep your pants from slipping down!
quests.funFact: The buckle on a belt can be plain or shaped like something fun.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear on our feet when we walk outside?
quests.question: Shoes
quests.hint: Think about this: You wear socks underneath these.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Shoes protect your feet when you walk, run, and play outside!
quests.funFact: The left shoe and the right shoe are shaped a tiny bit differently.

quests.instruction: What do we wear instead of regular clothes before jumping in the water?
quests.question: Swimsuit
quests.hint: Hint: You change into this before jumping in a pool.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Swimsuit is made to get wet and dry quickly for swimming!
quests.funFact: Swimsuits come as one piece or as two separate pieces.

quests.instruction: What do we wear with a hood we pull up to protect our hair?
quests.question: Raincoat
quests.hint: Hint: You wear this on drizzly, puddle-splashing days.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Raincoat keeps rain from soaking your clothes on a wet, drizzly day!
quests.funFact: Bright yellow is a popular color for raincoats, so you're easy to see.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear to bed every night before we go to sleep?
quests.question: Pajamas
quests.hint: Think about this: They are soft and loose, not tight.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Pajamas are soft and comfy, made for wearing all night while you sleep!
quests.funFact: Some pajamas have fun animal feet or hoods built right in.

quests.instruction: What do we wear at the beach or on a sunny car ride?
quests.question: Sunglasses
quests.hint: Hint: You wear these on a beach or on a bright day.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Sunglasses shade your eyes so bright sunlight does not hurt them!
quests.funFact: Sunglasses come in every shape, from round to square to star-shaped.

quests.instruction: What do we wear for a fancy outfit, worn over a collared shirt?
quests.question: Vest
quests.hint: Hint: You wear this over a shirt.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Vest covers your chest with no sleeves, so your arms stay free!
quests.funFact: A bright orange safety vest helps workers be seen easily.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that is soft, warm, and easy to slide on?
quests.question: Slippers
quests.hint: Hint: They keep your feet warm on a cold floor.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Slippers are soft and easy to slide on, perfect for relaxing at home!
quests.funFact: Fuzzy slippers keep your feet warm on cold morning floors.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that we change for a clean pair every single day?
quests.question: Underwear
quests.hint: Hint: No one else can see it once you're dressed.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Underwear is worn closest to your skin, under all your other clothes!
quests.funFact: Underwear comes in soft, comfortable cotton and fun colorful patterns.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear on the top part of our body?
quests.question: Shirt
quests.hint: Think about this: It has two sleeves for your arms.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Shirt covers your chest and back to keep your top half comfy!
quests.funFact: Some shirts have buttons, and some just pull over your head.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear that hangs down from our waist?
quests.question: Skirt
quests.hint: Think about this: It is worn with a top, not by itself.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Skirt hangs down from your waist and can swish as you walk!
quests.funFact: Skirts can be short, long, stripy, or full of colorful patterns.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that laces up snugly before gym class or a race?
quests.question: Sneakers
quests.hint: Hint: Athletes wear these during a race.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Sneakers have bouncy soles that make running and jumping comfortable!
quests.funFact: Some sneakers even light up with every single step.
